name: Certificate Automation — Hybrid v2 (Event + Catch-up + Backfill + Reporting)

parameters.content:
# CERTIFICATE AUTOMATION — HYBRID v2
**Event → PDF → Email | Nightly Catch-up | Manual Backfill | Weekly XLSX**

**Before activation:** connect Google Sheets, Drive, Docs, Gmail credentials and verify document/template/folder IDs. Keep synthetic data for demonstrations.

**Sheet columns:** `cert_id | name | email | course | score | status | created_at | issued_at | error | template_version | regenerated_at`

**Status:** `rejected`, `pending`, `sending`, `issued`, `delivery_unknown`. Other legacy `failed` rows may be retried by catch-up.

**Important:** Google Sheets duplicate check is not transactional. Do not claim exactly-once delivery.

## 01 — EVENT-DRIVEN ISSUANCE
Form → Validate → Dedup → Pending → Shared PDF generator

## 02 — NIGHTLY CATCH-UP · 23:00
Retry old `pending` / `failed` records (max 20). **Never auto-retry `delivery_unknown`.**

## 03 — MANUAL BACKFILL
Regenerate older issued documents using the current template; **do not email**.

## 04 — WEEKLY REPORT · SUNDAY 09:00
Read issued records → XLSX → manager email (ISO dates).

## 05 — SHARED CERTIFICATE PIPELINE
Set data → Copy Google Doc → Replace placeholders → Export PDF → Archive + Delivery routing

value.error: Gmail returned an error or acknowledgement was not confirmed. Verify Gmail Sent before retrying.

parameters.content:
## DELIVERY SAFETY
`pending` → **`sending`** (before export/email) → PDF → **`issued`** after confirmed Gmail success.
On Gmail error/unknown outcome → **`delivery_unknown`**, manual verification of Gmail Sent.
This prevents blind automated retries when an email could already have been delivered.
**Not exactly-once:** a crash *before* writing `sending` or a manual replay can still duplicate artifacts.
Google Sheets does not provide atomic transactions.
Check node errors and reconnect credentials after import.

## BACKFILL GUARDBAND
Only records with `status=issued` and old `template_version` are selected.
Template regenerated PDFs are archived, no student email, `status` remains `issued` and `regenerated_at` is updated.
Drive files can duplicate on repeated runs; consider file-ID tracking in a later version.
